label: Parses as SQL
detail: The text is turned into a syntax tree. Anything that is not valid SQL stops here.

label: Exactly one statement
detail: A second statement smuggled in after a semicolon is refused.

label: SELECT only
detail: This is a read-only assistant: no DELETE, UPDATE, DROP or any other write.

label: Approved tables only
detail: Every table must be in the approved main schema, fully qualified. The private source tables are off limits.

label: Approved columns only
detail: Every column must be on the approved list, with or without a table alias.

label: No wildcards
detail: SELECT * could expose columns nobody approved, so columns must be named.

label: Approved functions only
detail: Only functions on the approved list may be called, so nothing can read a file from disk.

label: Row limit of 100 or fewer
detail: A missing limit is added as LIMIT 100. An explicit limit above 100 is refused.
